findings.detail: Stored issuer_name for Wash & Wax Holdings LLC leaked Equity, Consumer Services, Class A Common Share, and Initial Acquisition Date 4/30/2025 from adjacent schedule dimensions/columns.
Stored issuer_name for IMB Holdco LLC leaked Equity, Wholesale, Series Z Units, and Initial Acquisition Date 5/20/2024 from adjacent schedule dimensions/columns.

rationale: C206 is a within-row issuer_name parse-leak flag. The source schedule shows clean Portfolio Company names for the two current-period equity rows: Wash & Wax Holdings LLC and IMB Holdco LLC. The flagged extracted issuer_name values instead concatenate asset class/industry text plus investment type and initial acquisition date, so the stored issuer_name field is wrong while the raw source separates those fields. No aggregate anchor was needed.
